mapper.select: SELECT * FROM poi WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poi (type, name, district_id, admin_area, address, lng, lat, intro, illustration, official_url, stay_minutes, full_day, ticket_price, avg_cost, rating, tags, status) VALUES (#{type}, #{name}, #{districtId}, #{adminArea}, #{address}, #{lng}, #{lat}, #{intro}, #{illustration}, #{officialUrl}, #{stayMinutes}, #{fullDay}, #{ticketPrice}, #{avgCost}, #{rating}, #{tags}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE poi SET type = #{type}, name = #{name}, district_id = #{districtId}, admin_area = #{adminArea}, address = #{address}, lng = #{lng}, lat = #{lat}, intro = #{intro}, illustration = #{illustration}, official_url = #{officialUrl}, stay_minutes = #{stayMinutes}, full_day = #{fullDay}, ticket_price = #{ticketPrice}, avg_cost = #{avgCost}, rating = #{rating}, tags = #{tags} WHERE id = #{id}
